name: Amendments by the committee responsible – separate vote
title: REPORT on the proposal for a regulation of the European Parliament and of the Council on the Union Civil Protection Mechanism and Union support for health emergency preparedness and response, and repealing Decision No 1313/2013/EU (Union Civil Protection Mechanism)
part_text: (9b) In order to ensure cohesion and complementarity with other Union policies, implementation of the Union Mechanism should be aligned, where relevant, with the national and regional partnership plans adopted under the multiannual financial framework for the period 2028 to 2034. This alignment should enable a better integration of disaster risk management into strategic and investment planning at national and regional level.
